learning_outcomes.text: Can know the languages used on Earth and the place of the Turkish Language among world languages.
Can express themselves by thoroughly internalizing the Turkish Language and be accepted in society.
Can better understand and use their mother tongue.
Can better use science and knowledge by mastering their mother tongue.
Acquires self-confidence and creativity in written and oral expression.

syllabus_topics: Problems related to the spelling of foreign-origin words accompanied by texts.
Writing types related to daily life (Essay, conversation).
Examples of written expression types (Biography, autobiography).
Applications for correcting language errors (Spelling rules).
Rules to be observed in prepared speeches. Emphasis, intonation, technical applications.
